input.answer: I found what I came for: on the guide page there's a box called "תכנית חיסכון", with one line saying it's a bank savings plan where you put money in now and then, at a fixed interest, for a set time. I'd click that box next. But I only saw the box, not the page that explains it, and I'll ask you before I believe the rest of the site.

stuck.why: The middle form asks what it's for (דירה, חתונה, ילד…) and how much I have, every month, how many years. I didn't want to type in my money, so I looked to the left side instead.

stuck.where: Home page, the four boxes on the left
stuck.why: 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' sounded right, but it didn't say deposits or a savings plan by name. I wasn't sure it was mine until the next page.
The first suggestions there were קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן כספית. I don't know קרן כספית, and for a moment I thought that was what they wanted me to choose.
It's completely black, no writing at all. I didn't know if the page had ended or something hadn't loaded.

used: Home page heading 'מקור — להבין חיסכון והשקעה בישראל, עם מקור לכל מספר'
The line 'אתר אישי, לא מסחרי, בלי קישורי שיווק'
The box 'להבין סוג של חיסכון — מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
Cards 'פיקדון' and 'תכנית חיסכון' with their short descriptions
skimmed: The form 'מה השאלה שלכם?' with the buttons and the ₪ boxes
'שאלות שכולם שואלים' (the question about tax on deposit interest caught my eye)
The 'חיסכון עם הטבת מס', 'פרישה' and 'לילדים' cards
skipped: The third screenshot: 'לבחירה עצמית' and the whole 'במה הכסף מושקע' section with all the מדד, S&P, MSCI boxes
The menu at the top and the links at the bottom
unsure_meaning: מדד (here it seems to mean shares, not the price index from the news)
S&P 500, MSCI World, MSCI AC World (English letters)
not_found: The actual explanation page for 'תכנית חיסכון' (I only saw its box)
Who runs the site: no name, no bank, nothing official
A clear sentence saying which of these is as safe as a deposit and pays more
Anything about how much the bank takes from me on a deposit

findings.what: The whole site is black with thin grey writing. Even with the screen enlarged and my glasses on, the small lines under the boxes are hard to read.
findings.where: All screens, especially the card descriptions and the small grey lines under headings

findings.what: I have no idea who made the site. It says 'אתר אישי' and nothing more: no bank, no company. I wouldn't trust it with anything important.
The very first suggestions in the guide are things I don't know (קרן כספית), not deposits.
The second half of the guide is full of English letters and 'מדד' boxes. It made me anxious, so I stopped there.
Too many boxes on one screen. They all look alike and the descriptions are long.
The home page asks for amounts of money right away. It felt like it wanted something from me.
findings.where: Home page form 'יש לכם היום / ובכל חודש'

findings.what: The last screenshot is completely black.
